summary: Four-channel sound-chip instrument: three pulse channels with selectable duty and PWM, a 15-bit/7-bit LFSR noise channel, 16-step ADSR and hardware-style envelopes, per-track arpeggio, pitch sweep, vibrato and an optional 4-bit DAC stage. Use it for retro leads, basses, rapid chord arpeggios, metallic percussion and sound effects.
use_for: Retro sound-chip synth with three pulse channels, 15-bit and 7-bit LFSR noise, 16-step and hardware envelopes, per-track arpeggio, pitch sweep and 4-bit DAC grit.

parameters.name: P1 duty
parameters.how: Chooses the base duty cycle of pulse channel 1 between 12.5, 25, 50 and 75 percent.
parameters.sound: Fifty percent is hollow and full, while narrower settings sound thinner and more reedy.

parameters.name: P1 PWM
parameters.how: Sets how far the pulse-width LFO modulates channel 1 around its chosen duty cycle.
parameters.sound: Higher values add animated chorus-like motion to sustained notes, and 0 percent keeps the duty fixed.

parameters.name: P1 PWM rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the pulse-width modulation LFO on channel 1, from 0.1 to 20 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow rates create gentle drifting timbre and fast rates add a buzzy flutter.

parameters.name: P1 pan
parameters.how: Places pulse channel 1 across the stereo field from full left to full right.
parameters.sound: Panning channels apart separates counter-melodies and widens chords.

parameters.name: Noise mode
parameters.how: Switches the noise shift register between a 15-bit long sequence and a 7-bit short loop.
parameters.sound: Long sounds like crisp white noise for snares and hats, while Short has a pitched metallic buzz.

parameters.name: Noise pitch
parameters.description: Base noise clock rate at A4 (tracks the played note)
parameters.how: Sets the base clock frequency of the noise shift register at note A4, scaled by played pitch.
parameters.sound: Higher frequencies sound bright and sizzly like hats, and lower ones sound crunchy and gritty.

parameters.name: Noise pan
parameters.how: Places the noise channel across the stereo field from full left to full right.
parameters.sound: Shifting noise off-centre gives percussion hits room around centered bass and leads.

parameters.name: Noise MIDI ch
parameters.description: MIDI channel routed to the noise voice
parameters.how: Selects which MIDI channel plays the noise voice instead of the pulse voices, or All for noise-only kits.
parameters.sound: Leave on channel 10 to trigger percussion alongside melodies, or set All for dedicated noise presets.

parameters.name: Voice mode
parameters.description: MIDI and piano-roll routing across the three pulse channels
parameters.how: Chooses how MIDI notes use the three pulse channels: 3-voice round-robin Poly, single-channel Mono or stacked Unison.
parameters.sound: Poly plays three-note chords, Mono gives tight leads and basses, and Unison stacks all three voices thick.

parameters.name: Detune
parameters.how: Detunes pulse channels 1 and 3 symmetrically above and below channel 2 in Unison mode, up to 50 cents.
parameters.sound: Small values create warm beating and large values produce wide, rich chord-like thickness.

parameters.name: Velocity depth
parameters.description: How strongly note velocity scales volume
parameters.how: Controls how much incoming note velocity scales channel volume, from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Higher values make soft and loud notes expressive, and 0 percent plays every hit at full level.

parameters.name: Raw
parameters.description: Stepped aliased pulse edges instead of band-limited edges
parameters.how: Disables band-limiting on the pulse oscillators so raw stepped edges pass straight through.
parameters.sound: Off keeps high notes clean and alias-free, while On adds gritty high-frequency sparkle and foldback.

parameters.name: Env mode
parameters.description: Stepped ADSR or hardware-style envelope shape
parameters.how: Selects either the 16-step ADSR envelope or one of five repeating and one-shot hardware-style shapes.
parameters.sound: ADSR shapes traditional notes, while repeating hardware shapes create tremolo, bells and rhythmic pulses.

parameters.name: Env attack
parameters.how: Sets how long the 16-step ADSR takes to climb from silence to full level, from 1 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short attacks snap immediately for leads and drums, and long attacks swell smoothly for pads.

parameters.name: Env decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the 16-step ADSR takes to fall from full level to sustain, from 1 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short decays produce crisp plucks and long decays let notes ring down gradually.

parameters.name: Env sustain
parameters.how: Sets the held sustain level of the 16-step ADSR in discrete hardware steps from 0 to 15.
parameters.sound: Zero creates percussive plucks that die out while held, and 15 holds at full volume.

parameters.name: Env release
parameters.how: Sets how long the 16-step envelope takes to fade to silence after note-off, from 1 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases cut notes cleanly and long releases leave a stepped fading tail.

parameters.name: Env period
parameters.how: Sets the cycle length of the hardware-style envelope modes from 5 ms to 4 s when Env sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Very short periods add metallic ring modulation and longer ones create rhythmic volume pulses.

parameters.name: Env sync
parameters.how: Locks the hardware-style envelope period to a musical note division of the song tempo.
parameters.sound: Keeps repeating saw and triangle amplitude pulses locked cleanly to the beat.

parameters.name: Arp mode
parameters.how: Turns on the per-track rapid pitch arpeggiator and chooses the order it steps through the offsets.
parameters.sound: Rapidly cycles intervals to imply chords on a single channel with classic sparkling shimmer.

parameters.name: Arp steps
parameters.how: Chooses how many of the three semitone offset slots participate in each arpeggio cycle, from 1 to 3.
parameters.sound: Two steps give tight octave or fifth trills, and three steps play full triad arpeggios.

parameters.name: Arp step 1
parameters.how: Sets the pitch offset of the first arpeggio step relative to the played note, from -24 to +24 semitones.
parameters.sound: Leave at 0 semitones to anchor the root note or shift it for transposed figures.

parameters.name: Arp step 2
parameters.how: Sets the pitch offset of the second arpeggio step relative to the played note, from -24 to +24 semitones.
parameters.sound: Set +3 for minor or +4 for major triads, or +5 and +7 for punchy fourths and fifths.

parameters.name: Arp step 3
parameters.how: Sets the pitch offset of the third arpeggio step relative to the played note, from -24 to +24 semitones.
parameters.sound: Set +7 for a classic triad fifth or +12 for a bright octave leap.

parameters.name: Arp rate
parameters.description: Free arpeggio step rate in Hz
parameters.how: Sets the step speed of the per-track arpeggiator from 1 to 60 Hz when Arp sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Faster rates blur individual pitches into shimmering pseudo-chords and slower ones play distinct notes.

parameters.name: Arp sync
parameters.how: Locks the per-track arpeggiator step rate to a straight or triplet note division of the song tempo.
parameters.sound: Keeps rapid chord arpeggios tight and aligned with drums and basslines.

parameters.name: Pitch sweep
parameters.description: Linear pitch sweep rate in semitones per second
parameters.how: Sweeps each note's pitch continuously upward or downward after note-on, from -96 to +96 semitones per second.
parameters.sound: Fast downward sweeps make laser zaps and snare punch, while upward sweeps create rising effects.

parameters.name: Vib depth
parameters.how: Sets how far the per-channel vibrato LFO bends pitch around the note, from 0 to 200 cents.
parameters.sound: Gentle amounts add singing expression to leads and high amounts create dramatic pitch warble.

parameters.name: Vib rate
parameters.how: Sets the oscillation speed of the pitch vibrato LFO, from 0.5 to 20 Hz.
parameters.sound: Around 5 to 6 Hz feels natural and vocal, while faster rates sound frantic and nervous.

parameters.name: Vib delay
parameters.how: Delays the onset of pitch vibrato after each note starts, from 0 to 2000 ms.
parameters.sound: Lets fast melody notes stay crisp and steady while long held notes bloom into vibrato.

parameters.name: Stereo spread
parameters.how: Widens the stereo positions of the three pulse channels and noise channel symmetrically from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Zero keeps everything focused in mono, and higher values open chords and unison wide.

parameters.name: Lo-res DAC
parameters.how: Quantises each channel's output to a 4-bit stepped DAC grid before linear stereo mixing.
parameters.sound: Adds crunchy, authentic low-resolution quantization grain and harmonic grit on quiet tails and sweeps.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.how: Sets the overall output level of the instrument from -40 to +6 dB, or silence at minimum.
parameters.sound: Balances the instrument in the mix without altering its tone or quantization grain.
